CustomObject.label: CMS Content Index
CustomObject.description: Points MaStoryContentController at the CMS content records that make up a GTM Offering's public page (industry story blocks, FAQ, site defaults). Exists because the CMS delivery API this org exposes can fetch one content record by Id reliably but has no working "list everything of this type" query -- see DEPLOYMENT.md. One row per CMS content record the page should show.
